# Released-writer compatibility fixtures

`tests.issue41_released_writer` generates the fixtures with the genuine bundle
archived from Git object `2f02be99f27e6a860c3115a9c62539b0812bc038` (0.7.1).
The driver uses real checkpoint, admission and report entries in disposable Git
projects; only Orca and GitHub ports are synthetic. It never edits a Pod record.
The tests restore the writer's bytes unchanged, exercising full-id criterion,
subgoal, correction (the original single-finding shape) and assurance proof, plus
an abbreviated-candidate objective. No live-native compatibility is claimed.

The archive also supplies the genuine 0.7.1 Governor journal validator, used to
read a new decision reservation marker without conversion. CI retains Git history
for these offline archived-writer checks. Generated projects and records are
disposable and never tracked; no host state or private source packet is used.
